<!-- pr-reviewer: 8876f60726066b15a1f39e90c72e218797db290b -->
Reviewer: MacBook-Pro.local pool job review-4140, Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5), mkinney / seat skull; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: ready for the maintainer to merge.** I found no blockers.

This is a SAFETY-tier review: the PR changes the closed check of stock simulation and the stock export. It does not change posted G-code, gouge checks or collision checks.

## What looks good

- `unpaired_edges` uses the same 1e-9 weld as `open_edges`. Both counts read one shared helper (`edge_uses`), so the two counts cannot drift apart.
- A failed check refuses the mesh. `extract_with` falls back to the marching mesh. `machined_mesh` returns an `Err` and writes no file. This obeys the Prime Directive: a mesh that is not a solid is not written as a solid.
- I read the marching-tetrahedra code (`tet`, `NODE_SNAP`). A crossing within `NODE_SNAP` of a sample goes onto the sample, and `push` drops the zero-area facets. Thus a collapsed facet from the marching path is unlikely, and the new count should not refuse normal marching meshes. The author's readings (all 4 export meshes and all 5 marching meshes pass) agree.
- `iso.rs` goes down to 355 lines. The new file `iso_edges.rs` has a provenance line. `iso` re-exports both counts, so the caller paths do not change. `stock_sim/mod.rs` does not declare `iso_edges` a second time.
- The body has `Changelog:`, `Fixes #4122` and a decision file (`docs/decisions/4122-solid-edges.md`). The commit subjects are conventional. No process file, UI file, snapshot, golden, `testdata/` file or dependency changes.

## Results, merged with upstream/main `dc3679fb5` (locally)

Trial merge: clean, no conflicts. HEAD^1 = `8876f6072` (the PR head).

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 86 steps planned.
  - 47 sim and motion steps: all green.
  - Step 48 `app build (--no-run)`: FAIL, compile error in `crates/app/tests/start_exit_shared/hole_order.rs:74` (`missing field entry in initializer of OpParams::Bore`). The PR does not touch this file or `OpParams`. I built the same test target on bare upstream/main `dc3679fb5`, and it fails with the same error. This is a break on main (after #3832 and #4116 merged), not from this PR. Issue #4155 ("main is red") is open; I did not confirm that it names this error.
  - The 37 other app steps (the `lib` and 36 suites, `stock_export` included), run directly: 529 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --lib --test stock_export -- -D warnings`: clean. (`--all-targets` on `camcraft-app` stops at the same main break.)
- Extra suites run: `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib machined` (from `crates/ui`, the UI tests that read `machined_mesh`): 3 passed. No `testdata/` and no importer change, so no extra test-data or kernel STEP suites apply.
- Heavy lanes: not run. The diff does not reach a golden, a post or a catalog program.

## Mutations (re-run by the reviewer)

1. `extract_with` back on `open_edges`: `stock_dual::a_body_under_one_cell_never_panics_and_never_opens` is red (`Dual: every edge on two facets`, left 1, right 0). Restored: green.
2. `unpaired_edges` without the `a == b` (corner-to-itself) rule: `iso::edges::tests::a_facet_collapsed_at_the_weld_counts_as_unpaired` is red (left 0, right 1). Restored: green.

Both results agree with the PR body.

## Goldens moved

None. No `*.nc`, `*.cl` or `examples/catalog/**` file changes.

## Optional, non-blocking

- No test reaches the `machined_mesh` refusal through a mesh that only the new count refuses (the body says so). A small test in `crates/app/tests/stock_export.rs` could pin the new message text "edges not on two facets". Suggested follow-up: P7.
- `#[path = "iso_edges.rs"] mod edges;` is correct, but a plain child module (`iso/edges.rs`) is the more usual Rust layout. This is a style point only.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

left for the maintainer: check 6 skip - the PR changes the stock-simulation closed check and the stock export (crates/sim, crates/app/src/stock_export), which the merge sweep may not merge. Counted review at 8876f6072 is clean (mkinney, safety-tier); the 8-step quick gate is green apart from the main-side break in crates/app/tests/start_exit_shared/hole_order.rs (issue #4155), which the reviewer reproduced on bare upstream/main dc3679fb5. Left open for the maintainer to merge by hand.
